Review: A Comfortable Stay in the Heart of New Friends Colony

I recently stayed at the Rose Mallow Hotel in New Friends Colony. It is a solid choice for anyone looking for a comfortable stay in South Delhi, offering a great balance of service and convenience.
The Highlights:
Excellent Location: The hotel’s position in New Friends Colony is perfect. It is situated in a nice, upscale neighborhood that is central enough to access the rest of Delhi easily, yet feels a bit more relaxed than the city center.
Warm Hospitality: The staff here are truly a credit to the hotel. They were incredibly friendly and went out of their way to ensure I had everything I needed during my stay.
Fantastic Food: One of the best parts of the experience was the food. Everything I ordered was fresh and flavorful—the kitchen team clearly takes pride in their work.
Room for Improvement:
The only reason I’m not giving a full five stars is the check-in process. Even though I had opted for an express check-in, it didn't quite work out as planned. Despite the pre-registration, the rooms were still only allotted at the standard check-in time. It felt like the "express" benefit wasn't fully utilized by the front desk, and I ended up waiting just like a regular walk-in. Streamlining this to honor the express option would make a big difference.
Final Thoughts:
Once I was in the room, the experience was flawless. If you value good food and a helpful team, Rose Mallow is a great pick—just don't expect an early entry even if you've pre-booked the express service.

Very Bad Experience – Highly Disappointed

Our stay at Rosemallow Hotel, Delhi was extremely disappointing. We had booked multiple rooms for one night, but the condition of the hotel was unacceptable.

The rooms were very dirty and unhygienic. The cupboards were broken, and overall maintenance was very poor. Basic cleanliness standards were not followed at all, which made the stay uncomfortable and unpleasant.

This hotel is not suitable for families or group stays. Considering the condition of the rooms, it does not justify the booking or the expectations shown online.

I would strongly not recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a clean and comfortable stay in Delhi.

Very disappointing experience at Hotel Rose Mallow. There was excessive noise from another room late at night, and the management failed to take prompt action even after repeated complaints. Guest safety and comfort, especially for women, need serious improvement.
